Test Case Name: Verify CDSPI Medical Malpractice product availability
Description: Validate product availability for an eligible applicant and jurisdiction
Action: 1. Open a new policy transaction; 2. Enter an eligible applicant; 3. Select an eligible jurisdiction [TBD]; 4. Open product selection
Expected Result: The CDSPI Medical Malpractice product is displayed and available for selection

Test Case Name: Start eligible CDSPI Medical Malpractice transaction
Description: Validate that an eligible user can start the transaction
Action: 1. Select CDSPI Medical Malpractice; 2. Select an eligible transaction type [TBD]; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The Medical Malpractice workflow opens and the required data sections are displayed

Description: Validate acceptance of valid applicant and insured information
Action: 1. Open the CDSPI Medical Malpractice workflow; 2. Enter a valid applicant or insured name; 3. Leave the field
Expected Result: The applicant or insured name is accepted and no validation error is displayed

Test Case Name: Enter valid practitioner and practice information
Description: Validate acceptance of valid practitioner type specialty and practice location
Action: 1. Select an eligible practitioner type and specialty [TBD]; 2. Enter a valid practice location; 3. Continue
Expected Result: The practitioner and practice information is accepted and saved

Test Case Name: Save valid applicant and risk information
Description: Validate that completed applicant and risk information can be saved
Action: 1. Complete all required applicant and risk fields with valid data; 2. Click Save; 3. Reopen the transaction
Expected Result: The transaction is saved and all entered values are retained

Description: Validate selection of an allowed coverage limit
Action: 1. Complete valid risk information; 2. Open coverage options; 3. Select an allowed coverage limit [TBD]
Expected Result: The selected coverage limit is accepted and displayed in the coverage section

Description: Validate selection of an allowed deductible
Action: 1. Complete valid risk information; 2. Open deductible options; 3. Select an allowed deductible [TBD]
Expected Result: The selected deductible is accepted and displayed in the coverage section

Test Case Name: Select permitted endorsement or optional protection
Description: Validate that an allowed optional endorsement can be selected
Action: 1. Complete valid risk information; 2. Open endorsements or optional protections; 3. Select a permitted option [TBD]
Expected Result: The option is selected and any dependent fields or premium changes are displayed according to configuration

Description: Validate premium calculation and display for valid rating inputs
Action: 1. Complete valid applicant risk and coverage information; 2. Click Quote
Expected Result: The system calculates the configured premium and displays applicable charges and total premium

Description: Validate save quote bind and issue behavior after all approvals are complete
Action: 1. Complete valid transaction data; 2. Request a quote; 3. Complete required approvals; 4. Bind and issue the policy
Expected Result: The policy is saved quoted bound and issued with the selected coverage and correct policy status

Description: Validate product availability when the jurisdiction is not eligible
Action: 1. Start a new transaction; 2. Select a non-eligible jurisdiction [TBD]; 3. Open product selection
Expected Result: CDSPI Medical Malpractice is unavailable or the system displays the configured eligibility message

Description: Validate required-field behavior for applicant or insured name
Action: 1. Open an eligible transaction; 2. Leave applicant or insured name empty; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: A field-level validation message is displayed and progression is blocked

Description: Validate required-field behavior for practitioner type or specialty
Action: 1. Enter valid applicant information; 2. Leave practitioner type or specialty empty; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The missing field is identified with a validation message and progression is blocked

Description: Validate location and jurisdiction rules for practice information
Action: 1. Enter applicant and practitioner information; 2. Enter an invalid or unsupported practice location [TBD]; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The location is rejected and the configured validation message is displayed

Description: Validate required effective-date behavior
Action: 1. Complete all other required fields; 2. Leave effective date empty; 3. Click Quote
Expected Result: The effective-date field displays a validation message and quoting is blocked

Description: Validate configured effective-date constraints
Action: 1. Enter an invalid or disallowed effective date [TBD]; 2. Complete the remaining fields; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The date is rejected and the configured date validation message is displayed

Description: Validate that an unconfigured coverage limit cannot be selected or submitted
Action: 1. Complete valid risk information; 2. Attempt to select or enter an unavailable coverage limit [TBD]; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The unavailable limit cannot be submitted and the system displays the configured validation message

Description: Validate that an unconfigured deductible cannot be selected or submitted
Action: 1. Complete valid risk information; 2. Attempt to select or enter an unavailable deductible [TBD]; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: The unavailable deductible cannot be submitted and the system displays the configured validation message

Test Case Name: Block quote when required data is incomplete
Description: Validate that incomplete information prevents quoting
Action: 1. Complete only part of the required applicant and risk information; 2. Click Quote
Expected Result: Field-level validation messages identify incomplete data and no quote is completed

Test Case Name: Create underwriting referral for qualifying risk
Description: Validate configured referral behavior for a risk requiring review
Action: 1. Enter risk data that meets a referral condition [TBD]; 2. Complete coverage selection; 3. Click Quote or Bind
Expected Result: The system creates the configured underwriting referral displays the referral status and prevents completion until resolved

Test Case Name: Prevent bind while referral is unresolved
Description: Validate that an unresolved referral blocks policy completion
Action: 1. Create a qualifying referral; 2. Leave the referral unresolved; 3. Click Bind
Expected Result: Binding is blocked and the unresolved referral action is clearly displayed

Test Case Name: Accept minimum valid years in practice
Description: Validate the configured minimum boundary for years in practice
Action: 1. Enter the minimum valid years in practice [TBD]; 2. Complete other required data; 3. Continue
Expected Result: The minimum valid value is accepted

Description: Validate lower-bound behavior for years in practice
Action: 1. Enter a value below the configured minimum [TBD]; 2. Complete other required data; 3. Continue
Expected Result: The value is rejected and the configured range validation message is displayed

Test Case Name: Accept maximum valid years in practice
Description: Validate the configured maximum boundary for years in practice
Action: 1. Enter the maximum valid years in practice [TBD]; 2. Complete other required data; 3. Continue
Expected Result: The maximum valid value is accepted

Description: Validate upper-bound behavior for years in practice
Action: 1. Enter a value above the configured maximum [TBD]; 2. Complete other required data; 3. Continue
Expected Result: The value is rejected and the configured range validation message is displayed

Description: Validate that conditional fields appear when a configured answer requires additional information
Action: 1. Select a risk answer that triggers additional information [TBD]; 2. Observe the form
Expected Result: The dependent field or section appears and is marked required when configured

Description: Validate that dependent fields respond when the triggering answer is changed
Action: 1. Trigger a conditional field; 2. Enter a value; 3. Change the triggering answer so the field is not applicable
Expected Result: The dependent field is hidden or disabled and its value is cleared or ignored according to configuration

Description: Validate recovery after invalid information is corrected
Action: 1. Submit an incomplete or invalid form; 2. Correct each highlighted field with valid data; 3. Click Continue
Expected Result: Validation messages clear after correction and the workflow proceeds

Test Case Name: Retain data after save and return
Description: Validate that saved data persists across workflow navigation
Action: 1. Enter valid applicant risk and coverage data; 2. Save; 3. Navigate away; 4. Return to the transaction
Expected Result: All saved data is retained and displayed in the corresponding sections

Test Case Name: Attach correct CDSPI documents after quote
Description: Validate document attachment for a quoted eligible transaction
Action: 1. Complete valid data and coverage; 2. Quote the policy; 3. Open the document list
Expected Result: Required CDSPI Medical Malpractice documents are attached with the configured version and effective date

Description: Validate document generation during policy issuance
Action: 1. Complete all validations and approvals; 2. Issue the policy; 3. Open generated documents
Expected Result: Required issued-policy documents are generated and the correct form editions are displayed

Description: Validate retention of inputs changes referrals approvals and documents
Action: 1. Complete a transaction with a saved change and referral; 2. Resolve required approval; 3. Open transaction history
Expected Result: The audit history displays relevant inputs changes referrals approvals and generated documents
